source_caption_text:
When a reporter questioned Lil Durk on his beef with NBA Youngboy 👀

Lil Durk and NBA YoungBoy had a well-documented and high-profile feud that spanned several years. The tension severely escalated following the November 2020 death of Chicago rapper King Von—a close friend and Only the Family (OTF) affiliate of Lil Durk—who was fatally shot during an altercation involving an associate of NBA YoungBoy’s signee, Quando Rondo.

The fallout spread heavily into their music and social media, with both artists releasing diss tracks targeted at each other. Lil Durk took aim at NBA YoungBoy on songs like “AHHH HA,” while YoungBoy quickly responded with the track “I Hate YoungBoy,” where he dissed Durk, his crew, and his personal life. The feud created a noticeable divide in the hip-hop industry, with many artists and producers choosing sides or avoiding collaborations to stay out of the crossfire.

By May 2023, media personality DJ Akademiks publicly claimed that the two rappers had squashed their beef behind the scenes. Lil Durk subtly supported these claims by liking social media posts about the news and playing coy in interviews, signaling that both sides had moved past the active conflict to focus on their respective careers and families.
